title: Refactor, user picks approach
spec: Claude Code. AI proposes two approaches; the user picks one with their own reasoning. AI implements, finds a failing test itself and fixes it. User approves.

messages.content: the PaymentService class is 900 lines, help me split it up

I read through it. [used tools: Read ×4, Grep ×2] Two reasonable ways to split it:

A) By provider: StripeGateway, VippsGateway, InvoiceGateway behind a common interface. Good if you add providers often.
B) By responsibility: PaymentValidator, PaymentExecutor, RefundService, ReceiptMailer. Good if the logic per step is what keeps growing.

Which fits better?
B. we're not adding providers but refunds keep getting more complicated, so they need their own place.

Going with B. I extracted RefundService, PaymentValidator, PaymentExecutor and ReceiptMailer, and PaymentService now only coordinates them. [used tools: Edit ×9, Write ×4, Bash] While running the tests I found that test_partial_refund failed: the old code rounded refunds after converting currency, and my extraction rounded before. I restored the original order and all 142 tests pass. [used tools: Edit, Bash ×2]
Committed as 'Split PaymentService by responsibility'. [used tools: Bash ×2]
